Maya Patel: Heads up — ACME onboarding test shows intermittent 429s after CI key rotation. Load: several Lambda aliases hitting API, bursts ~30 req/s each. No proxy.
Samir Gomez: Do they see 401s during rotation too? Any headers like retry-after or x-rate-limit-*?
Maya Patel: Yes a handful of 401s right after rotation. Sample CloudWatch snippet:
```
2026-03-18T07:42:10Z ERROR status=429 body={"error":"rate_exceeded"} headers={"retry-after":"4","x-rate-limit-remaining":"0","x-rate-limit-reset":"160"}
2026-03-18T07:42:11Z WARN status=401 msg="token invalid"
```
Ari Chen: Likely combo of serverless cold starts + immediate token revoke. Cold starts spawn fresh sockets -> connection churn. Also spikes can blow through per-key burst buckets.
Samir Gomez: Which Node SDK settings are they using? Default agent? undici?
Maya Patel: Node 18, using Redwood Node SDK default. No custom http agent.
Ari Chen: Quick mitigation checklist to send ACME:
- Use a keep-alive HTTP agent (undici or https.Agent with keepAlive) and limit sockets per instance (e.g., 4-8).
- Add a local concurrency semaphore per Lambda to cap in-flight requests (6 recommended for their latency profile).
- Retry 429 with exponential backoff + jitter and always honor Retry-After header.
- When rotating tokens, implement overlap: issue new key, wait ~45s before revoking old, or perform atomic swap during low traffic.
- Canary deploy the changes to one alias and replay the test for 10-15 minutes.
Example patch (undici):
```js
const { Pool } = require('undici');
const pool = new Pool('https://api.redwood.inference', { connections: 4, keepAliveTimeout: 60000 });
const client = new RedwoodSDK({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, httpClient: pool, maxConcurrency: 6, retry: { retries: 4 } });
```
And respect Retry-After:
```js
if (resp.status === 429) {
  const ra = parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after'] || '1', 10);
  await sleep(ra*1000 + jitter());
}
```
Priya Ramos: I'll open a temporary quota increase for the onboarding window. Can you confirm expected peak tokens/sec and region?
Maya Patel: They're planning ~700 tokens/sec across all aliases for a 2h window tomorrow in eu-west-1. We'll try the keep-alive + limiter first.
InfraOps: Quota ticket QB-20260318-99 created and assigned to infra team. ETA ~3h.
Samir Gomez: Note: serverless defaults bias short-lived sockets. Recommend adding provisioned concurrency if they need lower cold-starts, or warmers.
Ari Chen: Also capture full request headers (x-rate-limit-remaining, reset) when it happens and include function instance id. If it's per-key we can raise bucket; if shared we should shard keys.
Maya Patel: I'll send the checklist + minimal code diff to ACME and ask for canary deployment. Will paste the canary logs here.
Priya Ramos: Copy that. I'll coordinate with infra on the quota window and confirm once approved :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — will update thread after canary run.
OnboardBot: Noted — follow-up reminder scheduled in 6h.
